Proximity marketing will push location based service revenues to nearly $13 billion over the next few years.

SatNews Daily - March 23, 2011 - GTX Corp (OTCBB: GTXO) and ADAM, Inc. have

entered into an exclusive revenue share agreement allowing 123 Chambers of Commerce representing more than 100,000 businesses nationwide to push out proximity alert promotions, using the GTX Corp GPS/PLS Platform and leveraging its growing GPS Tracking Smartphone App user base. Gartner reports that 42 percent of consumers use their phone to check a store
location, 31% use it for a mobile promotion, and 17 percent use their phone for the actual purchase.
